lines.title: Presto XL Series Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Presto's standard-duty electric-hydraulic scissor lifts, rated 2,000 to 8,000 lb with 24 to 60 in. of travel.
lines.content:
XL Series lifts are Presto's rugged general-purpose scissor lift tables for work positioning and assembly. Standard models are listed with 24, 36, 48 and 60 in. of travel, and selected models and sizes are eligible for Quick Ship.

Capacities run from 2,000 to 8,000 lb, with platforms up to 48 x 120 in. Options include conveyor and ball transfer tops, fork pockets, portability kits and accordion bellows skirting.
key_features: Conveyor, ball transfer and bellows options

lines.title: Presto XW Series Wide Base Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Scissor lifts with 12 in. of extra base width for stability with platforms up to 5 ft wide.
lines.content:
XW Series lifts have a full 12 in. of extra width at the base, which makes them very stable and lets them carry platforms up to five feet wide without tipping, even with off-center loads at full capacity.

Models are rated from 2,000 to 6,000 lb, with standard base-and-platform sizes starting at 36 x 36 in.

lines.title: Presto DXS Series Compact Double Scissor Lifts
lines.excerpt: Small-footprint double scissor lifts with extended travel, rated 500 to 5,000 lb.
lines.content:
DXS Series lifts are industrial-duty compact scissor lifts with a smaller footprint than standard tables and a double scissor mechanism for extended travel. They suit work positioning, assembly, repair and inspection in factories, warehouses, retail stores and repair shops.

Models in the range are rated from 500 to 5,000 lb, with platforms as small as 16 x 24 in. A turntable top and bellows skirting are available.
categories: Lift Tables > Double Scissor Lift Tables

lines.title: Presto Tandem Scissor Lifts
lines.excerpt: Tandem and wide-base tandem scissor lifts for long loads, with platforms up to 204 in. long.
lines.content:
Presto Tandem Scissor Lifts put two scissor mechanisms under one long platform for handling long loads. Wide base tandem models add width for extra stability.

Models are rated from 4,000 to 12,000 lb, with maximum platforms up to 204 in. long and 84 in. wide.
key_features: Tandem scissor design for long loads
Platforms up to 204 in. long and 84 in. wide
categories: Lift Tables > Heavy Duty Lift Tables

lines.title: Presto Dual Scissor Lifts
lines.excerpt: Side-by-side dual scissor lifts for wide, heavy loads, rated 4,000 to 12,000 lb.
lines.content:
Dual Scissor Lifts use two lifting mechanisms side by side under one platform, giving excellent stability for wide loads and high capacities.

Models are rated from 4,000 to 12,000 lb, with standard platforms starting at 48 x 48 in.
categories: Lift Tables > Heavy Duty Lift Tables

lines.title: Presto XZ Series Floor Height Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Pan-style scissor lifts that lower to 3/8 in. for hand pallet truck loading, rated up to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
XZ Series lifts have a pan-style platform that sits just 3/8 in. above the floor when lowered, so hand pallet trucks can load and unload them where forklifts or stackers are not available, and workers can load them without waiting for a forklift operator.

Capacities run up to 6,000 lb, with several pan sizes to suit different loads.
key_features: Loads with a hand pallet truck
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Presto XZT Series Floor Level Lift and Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Floor-level lift and tilt tables loaded with a hand pallet truck, rated 2,000 and 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
XZT Series tables lower flat to the floor for loading with a hand pallet truck, then lift and tilt the load to the most comfortable height and angle, with each function controlled independently.

They are hydraulic scissor tables rated at 2,000 or 4,000 lb, tilting 30 degrees.
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Presto Hydraulic Scissor Lift and Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Hydraulic lift and tilt tables with independent control, rated 1,000 to 4,000 lb with 30 or 45 degree tilt.
lines.content:
These tables control lift height and tilt angle independently so loads can be set at the most comfortable height and working angle. The tilt cylinder is recessed into the lifting platform, which lowers the table's collapsed height.

They are available in 1,000, 2,000 and 4,000 lb capacities with 30 or 45 degree tilt.
key_features: Recessed tilt cylinder for a lower profile

lines.title: Presto AXT Series Pneumatic Lift and Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Air bag lift and tilt tables that raise to 36 to 43 in. and tilt to 30 degrees, rated 1,000 to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
AXT and heavy-duty AXST Series tables lift loads to a comfortable height and then tilt them, both functions controlled independently and driven by heavy-duty air bags. Tilt tops can be fitted with fixtures, lips and gussets for different baskets and containers.

Raised heights of 36 to 43 in. are available, with tilt to any angle from 0 to 30 degrees and capacities of 1,000, 2,000, 4,000 or 6,000 lb.

lines.title: Presto Light-Duty Scissor Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Low-cost light-duty scissor lifts in electric and foot pump versions, rated 1,000 to 2,000 lb.
lines.content:
Presto's light-duty scissor lifts are a dependable, low-cost choice for intermittent lifting and positioning. The XS Series adds a 1/3 HP electric motor for powered lifting, and the XF Series is raised with a hydraulic foot pump.

XS models come in 1,000 or 1,500 lb capacities with 24 or 36 in. of travel, and XF models in 1,000, 1,500 or 2,000 lb. Platforms range from 24 x 36 in. up to 48 x 60 in.

lines.title: Presto AX Series Pneumatic Scissor Lifts
lines.excerpt: Air bag scissor lifts that run on shop air, rated 1,000 to 8,000 lb in standard and heavy-duty versions.
lines.content:
AX Series lifts are raised by a heavy-duty air bag system and need no electricity, so they can be used anywhere shop air is available. With no hydraulic fluid there is nothing to contaminate the process, and they typically need less maintenance than hydraulic tables.

Standard AX models are rated from 1,000 to 4,000 lb, and heavy-duty AXS models add air bags for capacities up to 8,000 lb. A pedestal control is standard with foot control optional, and actuators carry a lifetime warranty.
key_features: Air bag lift on shop air

lines.title: Presto AXR Series Pneumatic Turntable Lifts
lines.excerpt: Pneumatic scissor lifts with an integrated turntable, rated 1,000 to 8,000 lb.
lines.content:
AXR Series lifts add an integrated turntable to Presto's air bag scissor lift, so workers can rotate the load to reach every side without walking around it. That helps where tools are only on one side of the table, and in palletizing where it saves stretching for boxes on the far side.

Standard AXR models are rated from 1,000 to 4,000 lb, and heavy-duty AXSR models up to 8,000 lb.
key_features: Air bag lift on shop air

lines.title: Presto DBP Series Portable Double Scissor Lifts
lines.excerpt: Battery-powered portable double scissor lifts for extended travel, rated 1,000 and 1,500 lb.
lines.content:
DBP Series portable lift tables use a double scissor design for maximum vertical travel in a compact size, and roll easily from one area to another. Pushbutton control positions the load for loading, offloading or use as a workstation.

Portability makes them a good fit for sharing one lift between work cells that don't each need their own. Models are rated at 1,000 or 1,500 lb.
categories: Lift Tables > Double Scissor Lift Tables
Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Presto XBP and WBP Series Battery Portable Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Portable scissor lift tables with 12V battery lift, rated 1,000 to 2,000 lb with lift heights up to 53 in.
lines.content:
XBP and WBP Series portable lift tables add powered lifting to a mobile scissor table. A hand pendant raises and lowers the load at the touch of a button, with power from a 12V gel cell battery and a built-in 5 amp charger.

Models are rated at 1,000, 1,500 and 2,000 lb, with lifting heights up to 53 in.
key_features: 12V gel cell battery with built-in charger
categories: Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Presto XP and WXP Series Manual Portable Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Foot pump mobile scissor lift tables rated up to 1,500 lb with raised heights up to 45-1/4 in.
lines.content:
XP and WXP Series tables are compact, very maneuverable scissor lifts for use as portable workstations, machine feeding tables and load transporters. A simple foot pump raises the platform.

They lift loads up to 1,500 lb to heights up to 45-1/4 in., on platforms from 20 x 32 in. up to 48 x 54 in.
key_features: Platforms from 20 x 32 in. to 48 x 54 in.

lines.title: Presto PT and PTS Series Portable Container Tilters
lines.excerpt: Battery-powered portable container tilters that tilt 0 to 85 degrees, rated 2,000 and 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
PT and PTS Series tilters are portable and battery powered, for sharing between work cells or for workers who pick up containers from staging areas and return them. Non-straddle PT units suit most standard containers, and straddle PTS units suit containers with reinforcing leg bars.

They come in 2,000 and 4,000 lb capacities and tilt containers to any angle from 0 to 85 degrees.
categories: Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables

lines.title: Presto SRT Series Stationary Container Tilters
lines.excerpt: Stationary container tilters with wide fork channels, tilting up to 89 degrees at 2,000 or 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
SRT Series tilters are for dedicated container tilting. Wide fork channels let containers be placed on them with a forklift, stacker or hand pallet truck.

A hand pendant tilts the load to any angle from 0 to 89 degrees, so even items at the bottom are easy to reach. Models are rated at 2,000 or 4,000 lb.

lines.title: Presto TZ Series 45 Degree Floor Level Tilters
lines.excerpt: Pan-style floor-level container tilters loaded with a hand pallet truck, tilting up to 45 degrees.
lines.content:
TZ Series tilters have a pan-style platform that lowers to the floor, so containers can be placed on them with a hand pallet truck. That suits facilities without a forklift or stacker, and lets workers load and unload containers themselves.

They tilt loads to any angle between 0 and 45 degrees, with capacities up to 6,000 lb.
key_features: Floor-level pan loads with a hand pallet truck
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Presto ZRT Series Floor Level Container Tilters
lines.excerpt: Floor-level container tilters that tip loads up to 89 degrees, rated 2,000 and 4,000 lb.
lines.content:
ZRT Series tilters have a floor-level pan so containers can be loaded with a hand pallet truck, then tilted to any angle between 0 and 89 degrees for access without bending and stretching.

They handle containers weighing up to 4,000 lb, and let workers keep their own pace without waiting for a forklift and certified operator.
key_features: Floor-level pan loads with a hand pallet truck
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Presto AT Series Pneumatic Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Air bag tilt tables in fourteen models, rated 1,000 to 6,000 lb with 35 or 45 degrees of tilt.
lines.content:
AT Series tilt tables are tilted by a heavy-duty air bag and mount directly to the floor or on an optional stand. A restraining chain prevents over-travel.

Fourteen models are available, rated from 1,000 to 6,000 lb, with tilt angles of 35 or 45 degrees.

lines.title: Presto TT Series Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Fixed-height tilt tables with 30, 45 or 60 degrees of tilt, rated up to 6,000 lb.
lines.content:
TT Series fixed-height tilters mount on legs, workbenches or the floor. They suit odd-shaped containers and loads, and positioning work for wiring, assembly and fabrication.

They are available with 30, 45 or 60 degrees of tilt and handle loads up to 6,000 lb.

lines.title: Presto WT Series Wide Base Tilt Tables
lines.excerpt: Tilt tables with a 36 in. wide base and platforms up to 60 x 60 in., tilting 30 to 90 degrees.
lines.content:
The 36 in. wide base of the WT Series adds rigidity and stability for larger containers and loads that need more side support. Platforms up to 60 x 60 in. are available.

They mount on the floor, on fixed-height stands or on a scissor lift table, with tilt angles of 30, 45, 60 and 90 degrees and capacities from 2,000 to 6,000 lb.
key_features: Floor, stand or lift table mounting

lines.title: Presto P3 Load Levelers
lines.excerpt: Pallet positioners with a turntable top, in airbag, spring and operator-controlled hydraulic versions.
lines.content:
P3 Load Levelers keep pallets at a constant, comfortable height as layers are added or removed, and a turntable top lets workers spin the load so they always work from the near side.

The All-Around Airbag model self-levels on an air bag charged from shop air, and can then be disconnected and moved, handling loads from 400 to 4,500 lb. The All-Around Spring model uses springs and shock absorbers and needs no power or air. The Operator Controlled model is fully powered hydraulic, for precise positioning when weights, pallet sizes or products vary widely.

lines.title: Presto P4 Floor Height Load Levelers
lines.excerpt: Floor-height pallet positioners loaded with a hand pallet truck, including a built-in turntable version.
lines.content:
P4 Load Levelers lower to the floor so they can be fed with a hand pallet truck, and footswitch controls let the operator set the load at the most comfortable height as each layer comes off or goes on.

Standard P4 models are rated at 2,500 and 4,000 lb. The P4 with Built-In Turntable adds a rotating platform that accepts a wide range of pallet sizes, and a 31 in. ramp with a gentle incline for the pallet truck.
key_features: Loads with a hand pallet truck
categories: Lift Tables > Floor Level Lift Tables

lines.title: Presto LP Low-Profile Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Low-profile pallet lift tables that collapse to 3-1/4 in., rated 2,200 lb, with a recessed turntable option.
lines.content:
LP Low-Profile Lift Tables collapse to as low as 3-1/4 in. and give four-sided access for pallet loading and unloading. An optional shallow ramp allows hand pallet truck loading, and an electromechanical toe guard runs around the platform perimeter.

The LP34-22 is rated for 2,200 lb and raises to 34-3/4 in. It can be fitted with a recessed turntable platform so workers can reach all sides of a pallet without moving.
categories: Lift Tables > Low Profile Lift Tables

lines.title: Presto U-Lift Roll-In Levelers
lines.excerpt: U-shaped roll-in pallet lifts loaded with a hand pallet truck, rated 2,200 lb.
lines.content:
The U-Lift Roll-In has a U-shaped platform: with the pallet truck raised, the pallet rides over the outside beams while the truck fits between them, and lowering the truck leaves the pallet supported at all four corners.

The design gives four-sided access with little or no reach-over. It is rated for 2,200 lb, lowers to 3-1/4 in. and raises to 34-3/4 in., with an electromechanical toe guard around the platform.
key_features: Loads with a hand pallet truck
U-shaped platform supports all four corners
categories: Lift Tables > Low Profile Lift Tables

lines.title: Presto Post Lift Tables
lines.excerpt: Portable post-style lift tables in hydraulic cantilever, battery-operated and hand crank versions.
lines.content:
Presto post lift tables are portable work positioners and transporters. The PL hydraulic cantilever table is raised with a foot pump through a two-stage telescoping mechanism, and its open area between base legs and top reaches over machine beds. BP battery-operated tables raise on a central 12V DC linear actuator with guide posts for stability, in 2 or 4 post styles.

The P Series hand crank table positions its platform on four self-locking acme screw posts that hold height with no drift, even at 2,000 lb. Capacities across the range run from 1,000 to 2,000 lb.
key_features: Hydraulic cantilever, battery and hand crank versions
Acme screw posts hold height without drift (P Series)
categories: Lift Tables > Battery Powered Lift Tables
